steps.title: Three steps, 50 times a second
steps.say: MWLib runs this loop for you. You never call readInputs or writeOutputs yourself.

board.code:
every 20 ms:
  1. readInputs()    // motors report position and velocity
  2. your code       // robotPeriodic(), teleopPeriodic() say what you WANT
  3. writeOutputs()  // the request goes to the motors

steps.title: Why split it?
steps.say: Your code only ever works with fresh readings and only says what it wants. That's an **IO model**, and every mechanism on the competition robot works this way.

steps.title: Open DifferentialDriveMech.java
steps.say: Press **Ctrl+P**, type `DifferentialDriveMech` and press Enter. Quick Open finds any file by name, so you never have to dig through folders.

steps.title: Find readInputs
steps.say: Find step 1 in the drivetrain. Press **Ctrl+F**, type `readInputs` and press Enter to jump to it.

steps.title: readInputs
steps.say: Here the drivetrain reads its motors. Scroll down to find `writeOutputs` too.
